user.title: Telink BLE add-on connection
user.description: Enter the host and port where the Telink BLE CLI add-on web UI is reachable (it listens on TCP 8099). In Home Assistant OS this is usually the machine's LAN IP.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Telink add-on. Check the host/port and that the add-on is running.
